record.question: The Battle of Plassey was considered as one of the most decisive battles of India because
options: Great feats of valour were shown by the opposing forces
It made the English master of Bengal and overran the whole India within the next hundred years
Robert Clive, for the first time showed his military strategem
The French in India were decicively beaten
record.explanation: The Battle of Plassey made the English masters of Bengal.
